sourceLocations: src/interaction/work_delegation.ts (the observation contract and the per-invocation tracker)
separationRule: observation state and source qualification are INDEPENDENT dimensions, never one confidence ladder
whatAnObservationProves: the Parent received a well-formed session-identity message on the channel of a ChildProcess it spawned
the Parent associated the report with its OWN invocation identity
the message reported a specific, well-formed DSH SessionId
whatItDoesNotProve: that the configured executable was an authentic first-party DSH Host
that the Session was created by an actual agents.create call
that the Session history is durable or complete
that the Worker passed capability admission
that the Attempt completed, was verified or was promoted
that the association survives a Parent restart
that the Session belongs to a durable verified association
